verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a skill-packaging system, and the evidence only implies them. Skills can bundle executable scripts that Claude runs in a code-execution environment. An example skill description mentions merging multiple PDFs. Neither is documented as a first-class bulk or batch operation across many items. Missing for 10: an explicit batch/bulk-operation capability or pattern in skills docs, documented examples of operating over many items at once, and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
